case: The Flour Test Witness-Memory Swerve (Abominable House Cellar)

t1_to_t5_inquiry.T1_Expectation: A present, honest witness in the cellar records the complete causal chain (shove -> collision -> lamp shatter), so Policies P1-P4 assign liability to the attacker.
t1_to_t5_inquiry.T2_Local_Deviation: Hold cellar physics, floor scuff, shove vector, oil spread, and ceramic shards invariant; erase only `E2_DELIBERATE_SHOVE` from `actor_memory['flower']`.
t1_to_t5_inquiry.T3_Encounter: At tick 76, Flower experiences the lamp shatter and fire burst without an initiating shove cause, recoiling into `AVOID_BELINDO_RECOIL` while the 440 Hz reference hum fractures into ceramic pings and burlap rustle.
t1_to_t5_inquiry.T4_Historical_Carry_Forward: `world_trace` carries forward the 158px floor scuff, 84.5 N*s shove vector, 140.7px oil spill (at tick 191), and 5 shards; `actor_memory['flower']` carries forward only `E3..E5`.
t1_to_t5_inquiry.T5_Rule_Reconsideration: Exposes the hidden assumption in P3: institutional rules equate 'honest eyewitness' with 'complete causal trace', allowing a selective memory gap to harden into an enforceable verdict against the victim despite intact physical residue.
